verdict.rationale: Sill's own repo says taps and clicks, momentum scrolling, an on-screen trackpad, keys and typed text, and Apple Pencil as pointer all reach the Mac. An attached keyboard types on the Mac (Esc included), and three-finger swipes and pinches trigger Mission Control, App Exposé and Spaces as on a Mac trackpad, which points to native host-side events. Missing for 10: explicit support for a physical mouse attached to the iPad/iPhone, documentation of how events are injected on the host, independent or hands-on corroboration.
